name: My Superstar, My Love
original_name: แผนรักร้ายของนายซุปตาร์
overview: Patt, a hardworking motorbike taxi driver focused solely on supporting his younger brother, never expected to cross paths with Leon, a glamorous superstar. When Leon dramatically pulls Patt into the spotlight during a heated public confrontation, Patt finds himself thrust into a chaotic new world. Reluctantly accepting a job as Leon’s assistant, Patt navigates the demands of a difficult boss, maintaining a complicated public façade, and living under the same roof as his new employer.
